finding.finding: When neither formula stock_specs nor formula dilutions supplies a material fraction, the G15 helper currently falls back to 1.0. gate_formula separately resolves inventory stock_specs for FormulaState/preflight, but does not pass those resolved stock_specs into _gate_g15_oav_firewall. This can make G15's local dilution view less strict than the inventory-resolved state, even though other hard preflight gates may still fail closed overall.
finding.risk: A missing or unpropagated fraction can appear as neat inside G15 rather than fail/resolve from current inventory authority. This is unacceptable as a canonical stock-lineage contract even if overall release remains blocked by inventory preflight.
safe_fix_contract: Pass the already-resolved child stock_specs from gate_formula into G15.
Resolve parent stock_specs through the same inventory contract before parent G15 comparison.
Do not silently default missing G15 stock fractions to 1.0 unless the exact resolved stock authority proves neat/as-supplied 1.0.
Add regressions for missing formula dilution plus resolved non-neat stock, product-basis/unknown fractions, and parent/child stock-lineage continuity.
Run repository-native pytest/compile/lint before applying the patch to a canonical branch.
